propositions: Four call sites cast to optional capability types (SupportsComments/SupportsLinks) using static cast() without runtime guards, so a transport missing the capability silently fails instead of alerting.

An AttributeError raised during capability method invocation is caught by a broad except Exception handler, causing the mutation to be skipped and reported as success rather than distinguished as a capability absence or real failure.

Runtime isinstance() guards against @runtime_checkable Protocol types must be added before the four capability call sites, with distinct INFO logging and bridge_alerts records for the 'capability absent' vs 'capability present but raised' cases.
_call_with_retry must be relocated from dispatch_one.py to dispatch_apply_phases.py to keep dispatch_one.py under the 800-LOC module-size limit after adding guards.

A proxying transport using __getattr__ satisfies hasattr() but fails isinstance() on Python 3.12+ (CPython gh-102433), requiring a fallback member check in addition to isinstance for correctness across interpreter versions.

The capability-absent path must not increment computed/applied counters and must not append to comment_errors, so that the silent-no-op failure detector in apply_handlers.py remains a pure failure detector.
